newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Controlling shareholder ups Chaifa stake.
newsitem.headline: Controlling shareholder ups Chaifa stake.

text.p: Controlling shareholder Chan C.T. Investments International Ltd told the stock exchange on Tuesday it had raised its stake in Chaifa Holdings Ltd by 8.20 million shares, or 2.82 percent of Chaifa issued share capital.

The Playboy-brand goods maker said earlier this month that Chan C.T. Investments, which is beneficiary owned by Chaifa's chairman John Chan, would hold 35.04 percent of the company on completion of a share placement on September 17.
Chaifa shares were down HK$0.025 to HK$2.225 at midday.
